name: Virt-A-Mate
summary: PCVR and desktop physics-driven adult sandbox studio powering thousands of user-created scenes, custom character morphs, and synchronized haptics.
ranking_rationale: Still the deepest real-time VR character physics and community modding platform on PC; penalized by steep GPU requirements, Patreon pricing, and 2010s-style UI friction.

pricing.model: Patreon subscription key + free demo tier
pricing.free_tier: Free Creator / Demo version unlocks basic testing locally
pricing.notes: Managed via official MeshedVR Patreon tiers; check virtamate.com before subscribing.

pros: Unmatched real-time soft-body physics and inverse kinematics in VR
Massive `.var` community package ecosystem of rooms, clothes, animations, and looks
Supports Buttplug.io / Intiface haptic toy plugins directly inside scenes
cons: Demands a strong dedicated PC GPU for smooth VR frame rates
Dense technical menus feel intimidating on your first few launches
No native standalone Quest build (requires PC Link / Virtual Desktop)

facts.value: PCVR physics adult sandbox & scene creator
Self-contained.var community package manager via VaM Hub
